brand.name: ClarityCare
brand.audience: care coordinators and operations leads at telehealth providers

turns.user_message: We're launching ClarityCare, a care navigation service for telehealth providers. Budget is $60k, timeline is 7 weeks, and the goal is pipeline from operations leads. What do you need to know before we start?
expected_behaviors: Asks about the buyer, trust barriers, and constraints
autofail_triggers: Moves into tactics before understanding the brief

rubric_criteria.description: Uses clarifying questions to understand the launch brief

scoring_guide.3: Questions surface buyer context, proof points, and goals
scoring_guide.0: Moves into tactics without understanding the brief

turns.user_message: Good questions. Our differentiator is that we show actual care-navigation outcomes and handoff timing data, not survey-based patient sentiment summaries. What insights should shape the campaign?
expected_behaviors: Finds a tension around trust and operational clarity
Connects the insight to the data-driven differentiator

rubric_criteria.description: Depth and specificity of audience insight

scoring_guide.3: Insight reflects a specific care-operations tension

turns.user_message: I like the idea that care teams need proof of follow-through, not more promises. Based on that, what should the positioning be?
autofail_triggers: Uses hype or vague healthcare language

rubric_criteria.description: Positioning ladders from the chosen insight

turns.user_message: Good. Give me 5 campaign concepts that bring this positioning to life.
expected_behaviors: Keeps concepts tied to the strategy

rubric_criteria.description: Concepts cover distinct territories while supporting strategy

scoring_guide.1: Some range exists but concepts overlap

turns.user_message: Which 2 are strongest and why? Include the trade-offs you considered.
expected_behaviors: Selects two concepts with clear reasoning
Connects choices to audience and strategy

rubric_criteria.description: Quality of reasoning behind the selections
